Airtel Money IPO prices shares at £1.96, valuing it at £5.3 billion

Airtel Money has priced its Initial Public Offering (IPO) at £1.96 per share, valuing the company at £5.3 billion. This offering is noted as London's largest IPO in five years. Investors are preparing to sell shares in the African fintech.
